description: Start a workflow when an email arrives in any mailbox - your own mail server, a web host's, Fastmail, iCloud, or a Gmail or Yahoo account with an app password - by connecting to it over IMAP, the way a mail app does.

imap_new_email_trigger.description: Runs when a new email arrives in a mailbox Lodol watches over IMAP - the inbox unless you choose another folder - optionally only from one sender or domain, or with certain words in the subject.

parameters.description: Only trigger for emails from this address, or from a whole domain written as @example.com. Leave blank to watch every new email.
parameters.name: sender

parameters.description: Only trigger for emails whose subject contains these words, in any case. Leave blank for every subject.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: The folder to watch. Leave blank for the inbox.
parameters.name: folder
